sphere.name: a sweep carries the ball up
a jump leaves it near the bottom
back and forth along a line
shaken hard along a line from high up: it leaves the wall
a small sphere, a big ball, much resistance, a coarse step

coil.name: the buttons the wrong way round
a heavy car on short steep ramps, fast from the middle

pit.name: blocks that slide, the longest run

elephant.name: from the rim to its height
a push it comes back from

wave.name: tuned for small swings, let go at 30°

harmonograph.name: phases past half a swing, heavily damped
near one to one, a coarse step

cone.name: a fat cone, wide short rails, a coarse step

parabola_spins.name: a shallow wide dish, faster, a coarse step

peg.name: the page's slack string, wound over the peg in flight
slack, then off the peg in flight
a long string, a coarse step

maxwell.name: a heavy wheel, a fat axle, soft strings

chaos.name: a light upper arm, the step cut to a seventh
unequal and damped, a coarse step

waterwheel.name: a strong brake, a coarse step
